title: A seminar at Strome
summary: Telehealth, continuity of care, and a chance to share our ongoing work.
body:
I presented “Telehealth and Continuity of Care in Mental Health Care Delivery: Evidence from a U.S. Nationwide Claims Database” in the Strome Research Seminar Series at Old Dominion University.

This is joint work with Shenghan Li and Kingshuk K. Sinha.
